description:
Xiaomi MiMo AI desktop client

The Xiaomi MiMo AI desktop client. Chat freely, create boldly, and bring ideas to life.
NotPet characters now include Bunny, adjustable sizing from 50% to 200%, and more natural movement and performance.
Usage quotas display cent-level precision, renewal and expiry prompts, card redemption history, and a sidebar quota ring.
The avatar menu now includes a message center, and new feature announcements appear once after sign-in.
The app menu supports update checks with progress shown in a window and confirmation before restarting running tasks.
HTML results open in the built-in browser, which now supports page annotations with highlights and snapshot sharing.
Performance improvements for a smoother experience.
Fixed several known issues.
source: Beijing Xiaomi Mobile Software Co., Ltd.
